bio.text: Jake Auchincloss represents Massachusetts's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, where he is serving his third term, and serves on the Energy and Commerce Committee.
He was born and raised in Newton, Massachusetts, graduated from Harvard College, and served in the Marines, commanding infantry in Afghanistan and special operations in Panama.
He served three terms on the Newton city council, worked in product development at an insurance company and a cybersecurity startup, and holds degrees from Harvard and MIT Sloan.
